complete_examples.text: Recently, Pletz et al. (2019) presented a quasi-static finite element (FE) model to explore the influence of rolling/sliding contact of wheels on the rail plastic deformation, where different plasticity models are applied and the 3D loads are trans-ferred to a 2D rolling model.
Certainly, the unrecoverable plastic deformation of track slabs can also be obtained.

Therefore, large wheel-rail local contact stresses are formed and produce significant damages on wheel/rail materials in the forms of wear, rolling contact fatigue, rail corrugation, and material plastic deformation, etc.
